title.english: A Place to Come Back To

pairs.target: dìèrshíyī tiān xiàwǔ , tǎ wéi zǒu xià xuégōng de cháng jiē , dào le huò péng biān .
pairs.english: On the twenty-first afternoon, Tavi descended the school's long stairs to the freight shed.
pairs.hanzi: 第二十一天下午，塔维走下学宫的长阶，到了货棚边。

pairs.target: zhèlǐ bǐ shàngmiàn nuǎn , shíqiáng dǎng zhe fēng , jǐliàng kōngchē tíng zài yánxià , chēyuán shàng dā zhe gǎnchē rén de shī wàiyī .
pairs.english: It was warmer here than above, sheltered by a stone wall. Empty carts stood under the eaves, drivers' wet coats draped over their shafts.
pairs.hanzi: 这里比上面暖，石墙挡着风，几辆空车停在檐下，车辕上搭着赶车人的湿外衣。

pairs.target: nài lěi zuòzài yìgēn dǎofàng de mù liáng shàng , zhèngzài gěi yìxiǎobāo dōngxī dǎjié .
pairs.english: Nerai sat on a laid-down timber, tying a small parcel.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾坐在一根倒放的木梁上，正在给一小包东西打结。

pairs.target: kànjiàn tā , tā téngchū pángbiān de wèizhì , méiyǒu wèn gōngkè .
pairs.english: Seeing him, she made room beside her without asking about lessons.
pairs.hanzi: 看见他，她腾出旁边的位置，没有问功课。

pairs.target: bāo lǐ shì gěi dùkǒu de xìn , háiyǒu qǐng rén zhuǎnjiāo de jiù cèshì tú .
pairs.english: The parcel held a letter for the ferry and old test diagrams for someone to pass on.
pairs.hanzi: 包里是给渡口的信，还有请人转交的旧测试图。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòxià , xiān kàn le yíhuìer zhuāngchē .
pairs.english: Tavi sat and watched the loading a while.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐下，先看了一会儿装车。

pairs.target: liǎnggè gōngrén bǎ cháng xiāng tuī shàngchē bǎn , dìsāngè rén zuàn dào xiàmiàn , qù gòu huáluò de shéng tóu .
pairs.english: Two workers pushed a long crate onto a cart; a third crawled underneath to reach a slipped rope end.
pairs.hanzi: 两个工人把长箱推上车板，第三个人钻到下面，去够滑落的绳头。

pairs.target: tā chūlái shí , tóufa shàng zhān le yìgēn mùxiè , tóngbàn kànjiàn le , méi gàosù tā .
pairs.english: He emerged with a wood shaving in his hair; his companion saw it and said nothing.
pairs.hanzi: 他出来时，头发上沾了一根木屑，同伴看见了，没告诉他。

pairs.target: " yàoshi zǎo zhīdào xīn suǒ sòng búdào , nǐ hái huìqiān ma ? " tǎ wéi wèn .
pairs.english: “If you'd known the new cable wouldn't arrive, would you still have signed?” Tavi asked.
pairs.hanzi: “要是早知道新索送不到，你还会签吗？”塔维问。

pairs.target: nài lěi shǒulǐ de jié dǎ dào yíbàn , tíng zài nàlǐ . " huì . nàgēn jiù suǒ bùnéng yòng le . "
pairs.english: Nerai paused halfway through the knot. “Yes. That old cable was unusable.”
pairs.hanzi:
奈蕾手里的结打到一半，停在那里。
“会。那根旧索不能用了。”

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu lìkè jiē huà . tā bǎ xiàntóu chuān guòqù , lājǐn , zài yòng mǔzhǐ yā le yíxià .
pairs.english: He didn't answer at once. She threaded the cord end through, pulled it tight, and pressed it with her thumb.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有立刻接话。她把线头穿过去，拉紧，再用拇指压了一下。

pairs.target: " kěshì qiānwán yǐhòu , wǒ zǒu dé tài zǎo . "
pairs.english: “But after signing, I left too soon.”
pairs.hanzi: “可是签完以后，我走得太早。”

pairs.target: tā shuōqǐ dùkǒu shí , méiyǒu cóngtóu jiǎng zìjǐ yílù shòu le duōshǎo lèi .
pairs.english: Speaking of the ferry, she didn't begin by recounting her own hardships getting there.
pairs.hanzi: 她说起渡口时，没有从头讲自己一路受了多少累。

pairs.target: shì suǒ nàtiān , chuánshàng zhī fàng le kōngxiāng , huí lā shí ànbiān de máo zuò lièkāi , suǒ zài tiě cáo lǐ héng zhe cāguòqù , liúxià hěn shēn yídào gōu .
pairs.english: During the cable test, only empty crates were aboard. On the return pull a bank anchor cracked, and the cable scraped sideways through its iron groove, leaving a deep gouge.
pairs.hanzi: 试索那天，船上只放了空箱，回拉时岸边的锚座裂开，索在铁槽里横着擦过去，留下很深一道沟。

pairs.target: chuán méi fān , rén yě méi shòushāng , dàjiā bǎ chuán tuōhuílái , wǎnshàng biàn tíng le dù .
pairs.english: The boat didn't capsize and nobody was hurt. They hauled it back and closed the ferry that evening.
pairs.hanzi: 船没翻，人也没受伤，大家把船拖回来，晚上便停了渡。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiǎngqǐ tā cóngqián jiǎng guò de nàcì lòujiǎn . nàcì tā chéngrèn zìjǐ méi kàn , zhèhuí tā kàn le , réngrán yǒurén bèi liúzài lù de lìngyìbiān .
pairs.english: Tavi remembered the missed inspection she'd once described. Then she'd admitted not looking. This time she'd looked, and people were still stranded on the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维想起她从前讲过的那次漏检。那次她承认自己没看，这回她看了，仍然有人被留在路的另一边。

pairs.target: " nǐ hòulái zhīdào tāmen ràolù le ma ? "
pairs.english: “Did you learn afterward that they were taking the detour?”
pairs.hanzi: “你后来知道他们绕路了吗？”

pairs.target: " zhīdào . dìyīcì huíxìn shuō , línshí de suǒ huì gēn xià yìpī liào zǒu . wǒ bǎ nàjùhuà chāo gěi le dùkǒu de rén . "
pairs.english: “Yes. The first reply said a temporary cable would come with the next supplies. I copied that for the ferry people.”
pairs.hanzi: “知道。第一次回信说，临时的索会跟下一批料走。我把那句话抄给了渡口的人。”

pairs.target: " dìèrcì ne ? " nài lěi bǎ bāo fàngdào xī shàng .
pairs.english: “And the second?” Nerai set the parcel on her lap.
pairs.hanzi:
“第二次呢？”
奈蕾把包放到膝上。

pairs.target: " dìèrcì wǒ zài biéde lùshang . xìn zhuīguòlái , yǐjīng wǎn le .
pairs.english: “The second time I was on another route. By the time the letter caught up, it was late.
pairs.hanzi: “第二次我在别的路上。信追过来，已经晚了。

pairs.target: huílái yǐhòu , wǒ yòu zhī wèn le nà pī liàodào le méiyǒu , méiyǒu wèn shǒu dù de rén hái zài bu zài . "
pairs.english: When I returned, I only asked whether the supplies had arrived, not whether the ferry keepers were still there.”
pairs.hanzi: 回来以后，我又只问了那批料到了没有，没有问守渡的人还在不在。”

alignment.english: whether the ferry keepers were still there

pairs.target: cén dù zuótiān dàilái de lìng yìtiáo xiāoxī , shì kānshǒu dùkǒu de yíhù rénjiā bān qù le shàngyóu .
pairs.english: Another report Cendu had brought yesterday was that a household tending the ferry had moved upstream.
pairs.hanzi: 岑渡昨天带来的另一条消息，是看守渡口的一户人家搬去了上游。

pairs.target: línshí suǒ jiùsuàn yùndào , yě dé chóngxīn zhǎo huì zhuāng , huì yòng de rén . búshì wǎng ànshàng yí fàng , chuán jiù néng zìjǐ kāi qǐlái .
pairs.english: Even if the temporary cable arrived, they'd need people to fit and operate it. Leaving it on the bank wouldn't start the boat by itself.
pairs.hanzi: 临时索就算运到，也得重新找会装、会用的人。不是往岸上一放，船就能自己开起来。

alignment.english: people to fit and operate it

pairs.target: tā shuōwán , wàng zhe péngwài nà liàng zhuāng le yíbàn de chē .
pairs.english: She finished and looked at the half-loaded cart outside.
pairs.hanzi: 她说完，望着棚外那辆装了一半的车。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi juéde tā xiàng zài tīng shénme , kě chē biān de rén zhǐshì zài zhēng shéngzi gāi cóng nǎbiān rào .
pairs.english: Tavi thought she seemed to be listening, but the workers were only arguing over how to run the rope.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维觉得她像在听什么，可车边的人只是在争绳子该从哪边绕。

pairs.target: " nà xiànzài ne ? " " wǒ yuē le cén dù yìqǐ bǎ lù chóngxīn hé yíbiàn . tā guò liǎngtiān qù kàn jiǎo , wǒ xiān děng huílái de xìn . shénme shíhòu zhēn néng zǒu , méi dìng . "
pairs.english: “What now?” “Cendu and I will review the route together. He's having his foot seen to in a few days; I'm waiting for replies. No date to leave yet.”
pairs.hanzi:
“那现在呢？”
“我约了岑渡一起把路重新核一遍。他过两天去看脚，我先等回来的信。什么时候真能走，没定。”

pairs.target: " nǐ huì qù ma ? " " kěnéng . qù yǐqián gàosù nǐ . "
pairs.english: “Will you go?” “Possibly. I'll tell you before I do.”
pairs.hanzi:
“你会去吗？”
“可能。去以前告诉你。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi diǎntóu , hūrán bú dà xǐhuan zìjǐ wèn chū de zhè jù .
pairs.english: Tavi nodded, suddenly disliking his own question.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维点头，忽然不大喜欢自己问出的这句。

pairs.target: tā jì xiǎng tā bié zǒu , yòu zhīdào zìjǐ gāngcái wèn de nàxiē shì , bùnéng quán kào tā zuòzài zhèlǐ huídá .
pairs.english: He wanted her to stay, yet knew his questions couldn't all be answered with her sitting here.
pairs.hanzi: 他既想她别走，又知道自己刚才问的那些事，不能全靠她坐在这里回答。

pairs.target: yìmíng gǎnchē rén guòlái ná bāo , nài lěi qǐshēn , bǎ bāo shàng de shōujiànrén niàn gěi tā tīng , yòu wèn tā rèn bu rènde xiàchē de dìfāng .
pairs.english: A driver came for the parcel. Nerai stood, read him the recipient's name, and asked whether he knew the delivery stop.
pairs.hanzi: 一名赶车人过来拿包，奈蕾起身，把包上的收件人念给他听，又问他认不认得下车的地方。

pairs.target: nà rén rènde , shuō shì shúlù , bǎ bāo fàngjìn zuò xià de gān gélǐ .
pairs.english: He did; a familiar route, he said, putting it in a dry compartment under his seat.
pairs.hanzi: 那人认得，说是熟路，把包放进座下的干格里。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe , méiyǒu bǎ zhèyíxià jiāojiē dàngzuò dùkǒu yǐjīng kāi le .
pairs.english: Tavi watched without taking that handover to mean the ferry was open.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着，没有把这一下交接当作渡口已经开了。

pairs.target: nài lěi huíshēn wèn tā yào buyào yìqǐ zǒu huí shàngmiàn . tā shuō hái zài zhèlǐ zuò yíhuìer , mǐlā hé yīwén yuē le děng xià guòlái .
pairs.english: Nerai turned to ask if he'd walk back up with her. He said he'd stay a while; Mira and Iven were coming later by arrangement.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾回身问他要不要一起走回上面。他说还在这里坐一会儿，米拉和伊文约了等下过来。

pairs.target: tā diǎndiǎntóu , shēnshǒu cóng tā jiānshàng niǎn diào yìgēn xìxiàn . " nǐ de yīlǐng yòu yào kāi le . "
pairs.english: She nodded and picked a thread off his shoulder. “Your collar's coming apart again.”
pairs.hanzi:
她点点头，伸手从他肩上捻掉一根细线。
“你的衣领又要开了。”

pairs.target: " wǒ yǒu zhēn . " " nà wǒ jiù bùguǎn . "
pairs.english: “I've got a needle.” “Then I'll leave it to you.”
pairs.hanzi:
“我有针。”
“那我就不管。”

pairs.target: tā wǎng cháng jiē zǒu qù , zǒuchū jǐbù yòu huítóu , shuō xiàzhōu tóngyìtiān xiàwǔ , ruò méiyǒu línshí chūmén , jiù dào gōng fāng zhǎo tā ;
pairs.english: She headed for the stairs, then turned after a few steps: come to the workshop the same afternoon next week, unless she had to leave unexpectedly.
pairs.hanzi: 她往长阶走去，走出几步又回头，说下周同一天下午，若没有临时出门，就到工坊找她；

pairs.target: yào gǎi shíjiān , huì tuōrén sòng huà . tǎ wéi táishǒu yìng le .
pairs.english: She'd send word of any change. Tavi raised a hand in agreement.
pairs.hanzi: 要改时间，会托人送话。塔维抬手应了。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu mǎshàng qǐshēn . nàliàngchē zhōngyú bǎng hǎo le shéng , chēfū zuòshàngqù , huítóu cuī tóngbàn , tóufa shàng de mùxiè hái méiyǒu diào .
pairs.english: He stayed seated. The cart was finally tied down; its driver climbed up and called to his companion, the wood shaving still in his hair.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有马上起身。那辆车终于绑好了绳，车夫坐上去，回头催同伴，头发上的木屑还没有掉。

pairs.target: mǐlā lái de shíhòu , huáilǐ bào zhe mùhé , yīwén tí zhe yìzhī kōng wǎn .
pairs.english: Mira arrived carrying her wooden box, Iven an empty bowl.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉来的时候，怀里抱着木盒，伊文提着一只空碗。

pairs.target: tāmen xiān qù fàntáng wèn jiè kuàizi , guǎnshì zhī kěn jiè liǎngshuāng , yāoqiú lián wǎn yìqǐ ná , miǎnde sàn zhe diū le .
pairs.english: They'd asked at the dining hall for chopsticks. The attendant lent only two pairs, insisting on a bowl too so they wouldn't lose loose pieces.
pairs.hanzi: 他们先去饭堂问借筷子，管事只肯借两双，要求连碗一起拿，免得散着丢了。

pairs.target: mǐlā shuō zìjǐ háiyǒu yìshuāng , zúgòu . " nǐ hái kànbukàn nàge wūdǐng ? " tā wèn .
pairs.english: Mira said she had another pair: enough. “Still want to see that roof?” she asked.
pairs.hanzi:
米拉说自己还有一双，足够。
“你还看不看那个屋顶？”她问。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng liáng biān nuó , gěi tāmen téng dìfāng .
pairs.english: Tavi shifted along the timber to make room.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往梁边挪，给他们腾地方。

pairs.target: tā bǎ kuàizi bǎi chéng yígè sānjiǎoxíng , yòng xì xiànshù zhù liǎngjiǎo , zài lā zhù xiàmiàn nàgēn .
pairs.english: She arranged chopsticks in a triangle, bound two corners with thread, and held the bottom stick taut.
pairs.hanzi: 她把筷子摆成一个三角形，用细线束住两角，再拉住下面那根。

pairs.target: shàngmiàn liǎnggēn xiǎng wǎng wài huá , xiàmiàn nàgēn bǎ tāmen qiānzhù , zhōngjiān biàn kōng chūlái , búbì zài lìzhù .
pairs.english: The top two wanted to spread; the bottom stick restrained them, leaving the middle open without another post.
pairs.hanzi: 上面两根想往外滑，下面那根把它们牵住，中间便空出来，不必再立柱。

pairs.target: " dāngrán zhēn wūzi bùnéng zhème hùnòng . " tā shuō . xiàn jié yì sōng , sānjiǎoxíng jiù dǎo jìn wǎn lǐ .
pairs.english: “Of course you can't cobble together a real house like this,” she said. A knot loosened and the triangle fell into the bowl.
pairs.hanzi: “当然真屋子不能这么糊弄。”她说。线结一松，三角形就倒进碗里。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ wǎn wǎng zìjǐ zhèbiān duān , xiàng jiē le yìwǎn gāng shàngzhuō de cài . " wūdǐng tāng . "
pairs.english: Iven drew the bowl toward him as if receiving a freshly served dish. “Roof soup.”
pairs.hanzi:
伊文把碗往自己这边端，像接了一碗刚上桌的菜。
“屋顶汤。”

pairs.target: mǐlā shēnshǒu qù qiǎng , tā bǎ wǎn jǔ gāo .
pairs.english: Mira reached for it; he lifted it higher.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉伸手去抢，他把碗举高。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào zhe ànzhù lìngyìtóu de kuàizi , jiào tāmen bié bǎ jièlái de dōngxī zhéduàn .
pairs.english: Laughing, Tavi held the other end of the chopsticks and told them not to break borrowed things.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑着按住另一头的筷子，叫他们别把借来的东西折断。

pairs.target: tā ràng yīwén duān wěn , suǒxìng jiù zài wǎn yán shàng chóngxīn dā .
pairs.english: She told Iven to hold steady and rebuilt it right on the bowl's rim.
pairs.hanzi: 她让伊文端稳，索性就在碗沿上重新搭。

pairs.target: zhèhuí sānjiǎoxíng lì zhù le .
pairs.english: This time the triangle stood.
pairs.hanzi: 这回三角形立住了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi còujìn , kànjiàn nàgēn héng zhe de kuàizi qíshí yìzhí bēngzhe , bìng bù yīnwèi méi chēng zài zhōngjiān jiù méiyòng .
pairs.english: Tavi leaned closer: the horizontal stick stayed under tension, useful even though it didn't prop up the middle.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维凑近，看见那根横着的筷子其实一直绷着，并不因为没撑在中间就没用。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn mǐlā shéngjié zěnme rào . tā chāikāi yìjiǎo , ràng tā zìjǐ shì .
pairs.english: Tavi asked Mira how to tie the knot. She undid a corner for him to try.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问米拉绳结怎么绕。她拆开一角，让他自己试。

pairs.target: yuǎnchù huòchē chū le yuànmén , chēlún yā guò shífèng , qīngqīng diān le yíxià .
pairs.english: The cart left through the distant gate, wheels bumping gently over a gap in the paving.
pairs.hanzi: 远处货车出了院门，车轮压过石缝，轻轻颠了一下。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi táitóu kàn le yìyǎn , yòu dīxiàtóu . yīwén hái duān zhe wǎn , búnàifán dì wèn , zhè dùn tāng jiūjìng shénme shíhòu néng chī .
pairs.english: Tavi glanced up, then bent his head again. Iven still held the bowl, impatiently asking when this soup would finally be ready to eat.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维抬头看了一眼，又低下头。伊文还端着碗，不耐烦地问，这顿汤究竟什么时候能吃。
